pagePromptSuffixes.hamburguesas: Use the original orange burger-bun graphic around title, and a large appetizing burger below list, WITHOUT a hand holding it. Only Spanish text; optional brand header BAR PLAZA.
pagePromptSuffixes.bocadillos-y-postres: For this page match green olive background in the bocadillos panel, cream white lettering and ornamental cream border; cream panel for POSTRES. Price columns Bocadillo and Montado must be distinct and precisely aligned. Include both sandwich cutouts, small line illustrations of supplements and cheesecake image. Only Spanish text; optional brand header BAR PLAZA.

ensaladasRevisionPrompt: Precise text edit of this recreated menu page. Change ONLY the top brand header from 'SPANISH BAR Plaza' to 'BAR PLAZA' in olive green, matching the other menu pages. Preserve every other pixel of the layout as closely as possible: all 12 dishes, every ingredient description, all prices, food images, cream background and green borders. Do not add or remove anything else. No English text.
commonPrompt: Create a polished, perfectly flat digital restaurant menu page, portrait, high resolution. Reference image is STYLE AND FOOD PHOTO REFERENCE only. Recreate the physical Spanish Bar Plaza menu's cream paper, olive green lines, heavy uppercase outlined headings, green script subheadings, dark sans-serif body, bold right-aligned euro prices and appetizing small photographic food cutouts. No hands, fingers, table, glare, perspective, folds, shadows, damage or cropped text. Full page with generous safe margins. Preserve every item and price from the EXACT TRANSCRIPTION below, with precise Spanish accents. Do not add dishes or ingredients. Use food cutouts matching the reference. Do not invent per-dish allergen symbols; add only footer 'Consulta los alérgenos en el establecimiento. SUPLEMENTO DE TERRAZA +8%'.
